title: Backtest Result Persistence (Parquet Storage)
description: Implement Parquet-based persistence for backtest results with schema versioning, columnar query support, and lazy upcast for backward compatibility.

criteria: Results persisted in Parquet format: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_persistence.py -p no:asyncio (exit code 0)
Columnar queries work: verify by query API test
Schema versioning in metadata: verify by metadata inspection test
Lazy upcast for backward compatibility: verify by schema evolution test
convergence.definition_of_done: BacktestResult can be persisted to Parquet and loaded with schema versioning and query support

files.change: Parquet read/write for BacktestResult, query API, schema versioning
Unit tests for persistence: save/load roundtrip, query API, schema versioning, edge cases

implementation.title: Implement Parquet persistence module
implementation.description: Create synapse/backtest/persistence.py with functions: save_result(result: BacktestResult, path: str) -> None, load_result(path: str) -> BacktestResult, query_results(start_date, end_date, factor_name) -> list[BacktestResult]. Use pd.DataFrame.to_parquet() with compression and schema version in Parquet metadata. Implement directory structure: results/{factor_id}/{run_id}.parquet, quintile_returns/{factor_id}/{run_id}.parquet, ic_analysis/{factor_id}/{run_id}.parquet.
modification_points: Create save_result(): convert BacktestResult to DataFrames, write to Parquet with schema_version in metadata
Create load_result(): read Parquet, reconstruct BacktestResult with lazy upcast for old schemas
Create query_results(): filter Parquet files by date range and factor name
Implement schema versioning in Parquet metadata (schema_version key)
logic_flow: Convert BacktestResult to_dict() -> DataFrame for metrics summary
Convert quintile_returns to DataFrame for per-quintile returns
Write each DataFrame to separate Parquet file with schema_version in metadata
For loading: read Parquet, check schema_version, apply lazy upcast if needed
For querying: glob Parquet files, filter by metadata fields

implementation.title: Write unit tests for persistence
implementation.description: Create tests/unit/test_persistence.py with 6+ test cases: save/load roundtrip, schema version metadata, query by date range, query by factor name, lazy upcast for old schema, edge cases (empty result, missing directory).
modification_points: Test save/load roundtrip: BacktestResult -> Parquet -> BacktestResult matches
Test query_results filters by date range correctly
Test query_results filters by factor_name correctly
Test lazy upcast: old schema version loads with defaults
logic_flow: Create synthetic BacktestResult with known fields
Save to Parquet, load back, verify all fields match
Query by date range and verify correct results returned
Test schema version is preserved in metadata

pre_analysis.action: Load feature spec for F-034 persistence and data-architect analysis

artifacts.usage: Parquet storage structure, query API, and schema versioning specification
Storage layer architecture, Parquet schemas, serialization patterns (Section 2)

context: BacktestResult and PerformanceMetrics frozen dataclasses from result.py

reference.schema_versioning: Weak Schema + Lazy Upcast pattern from ADR-005

rationale.why_parquet: Consistent with P1 market data storage, enables fast analytical queries on return/IC series
rationale.why_schema_versioning: Backward compatibility with existing BacktestMetrics schema

risks.risk: Parquet file size grows with long backtests
risks.mitigation: Use compression (snappy), separate quintile_returns from summary
Lazy upcast: old schemas load with default values for new fields
